title: Riparazione mirata delle code lente nelle teste esistenti
roadmap_relation: Sottotask41, non42; riparazione esplorativa dopo la diagnosi41o
trainable: Only existing parent.c/d equilibrium columns8,9,11,12,13 and parent.sc/sd SK equilibrium column0; joint_nap also existing parent.c/d update columns25,26. All trunks, corrections, donor and other heads frozen. Materialize into identical float32 state_dict; no wrapper at inference.
training_loss: Paired coefficient equilibrium error scaled1e-4, Nap relative log-update error scaled.01 for joint only, plus .25 mean held-input occupancy error scaled1e-4 at1/8/40/100/500/1000ms. Training scales are not scientific acceptance tolerances. Same target endpoints and minibatches both arms; independent clipping and Adam moments per arm/seed.
selection: Highest pass count on new development stress histories, tie earliest checkpoint. Report all budgets and case-level regressions. Freeze before opened41n re-evaluation. No claim of sealed independent confirmation.
success: Opened stress pass count >61/72 with no newly failed previously passed stress rows; no new development failures vs frozen baseline; no acquired native autonomous trajectory/response or imposed regression. Same cost protocol at1/642/4096, no qualified speedup claim until all quality gates pass. Any original FP32 floor failure stays explicit.
stop: Nonfinite, source SHA mismatch, zero-update materialization mismatch, optimizer/preflight failure or90minute worker budget: preserve partial logs/checkpoints; do not auto-retrain or change thresholds.

hypotheses.equilibrium: Updating only equilibrium readouts improves slow-tail timing without changing any other raw head.
hypotheses.joint_nap: Nap_Et2 needs joint equilibrium/update repair; joint arm rescues residual cases beyond equilibrium-only.
hypotheses.budget: Same trajectory checkpoints reveal optimization progress or plateau; no inference of unlimited scaling from one budget.
hypotheses.transfer: Any stress improvement must preserve acquired imposed/autonomous cases; shared coupled dynamics can still regress despite frozen other heads.

limits: Opened41n panel used only after new-development checkpoint freeze; diagnostic reuse, not independent confirmation.
Teacher coefficients are offline training labels only. No oracle state, reset, coefficient lookup or teacher rate formula in candidate inference.
Frozen-feature readout calibration may be capacity-limited; failure is not evidence against the full abstraction level.
No added parameters or extra inference operations; no Task42 authorization; failed original FP32 controls218/234 remain failed.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.
